directions.text: More flowing than before but alway calmly
More restful than the beginning, solemnly
Very fast and brightly cheerful.  Rhythmically.
Tenderly, hesitating, like an old folksong
Calmly and as evenly balanced as possible
Cheerfully flowing, but not too slowly
remains constant but strongly accented, more spoken
Strict quarter-notes, but not too fast.  Like a signal call
Somewhat faster and lighter than at the beginning, distinctly

In the previous tempo 
but quite softly and shadowy
